# Risk if fact identity invariant is violated

The codebase assumes Fact models lack identity ('slug') while Entity models include it; if this invariant is broken, downstream consumers that depend on identity-free facts or rely on separation of identity may behave incorrectly or leak identity information.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_smoke.py` — `tests.test_smoke.test_fact_ir_is_identity_free`
